description: This Java source file defines the RuntimeDelegatingCacheManager class, which implements the CacheManager interface and provides delegation to either a real cache manager or a no-op fallback. It manages switching between different cache modes (no cache, single node) and retrieving cache configuration details.

classes.name: RuntimeDelegatingCacheManager
classes.description: A cache manager that delegates cache operations to one of two underlying cache managers, allowing runtime switching between cache modes.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the currentCacheManager to the default cache manager after properties are set.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache by name from the current cache manager.

methods.name: getCacheNames
methods.description: Returns the collection of cache names available in the current cache manager.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Returns cache configuration data for the current cache state, indicating whether no cache or EH cache is enabled.

methods.name: switchToCache
methods.description: Switches the active cache manager to either EHCache or default cache based on the provided flags and cache type, returning a map of the changes made.

methods.name: clearEhCache
methods.description: Clears all caches within the EH cache manager.
